text:
alex: Heads-up: scheduled deploy for release v3.2.0 tonight 23:00 UTC. Starting this thread for preflight checks and final pin/rollback decisions.

maya: Quick question — are we pinning the runtime image and model to avoid drift? last-minute patching caused issues in the last rollout.

raj: Yes, recommend pinning runtime -> rni-2026-03-19 and model -> model-2.1.3-quant. We tested that combo on staging. If anything odd, fallback is model-2.1.2 + rni-2026-02-28.

alex: Decision noted: pin to rni-2026-03-19 and model-2.1.3-quant. PM Nina please update release notes and call out the pin.

pm-nina: Will do — adding notes + known-issues section. Link to draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/v3.2.0/draft (internal).

alex: Preflight checklist (quick):
```
- Run smoke: ./scripts/smoke.sh against canary
- DB migration dry-run: ./migrate --dry-run --target v3.2.0
- Toggle feature flags for canary: disable new-reranker, enable perf-cache
- Observability: ensure tracing + token-level cost logs enabled
- Canary config: 5% traffic -> 3 pods for 30m then 20%
```

raj: I'll run the migration dry-run and smoke tests. tagging @oncall-liz for alerting/PD during the window.

oncall-liz: I'm on for 22:30-00:30 UTC. PD escalation set to SRE rotation. Please @me in thread if canary shows >1% 5xx or latency regression >200ms p95.

alex: Rollback trigger rules (agreed):
- 5xx rate >1% sustained over 10m OR
- p95 latency increase >200ms vs baseline for 15m OR
- critical errors in logs flagged by error-regex (see release doc)
Action: immediate rollback to previous image and model tag, then open incident channel. Rollback command: `kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=rni-previous && kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference`

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: job_id=canary-1755009876, start=23:00 UTC, canary_pct=5, probes=health/readiness/trace.

maya: Small nit — ensure the KV cache TTL is same as staging (30s). Different TTLs caused flapping last time.

raj: Confirmed KV cache TTL = 30s in the canary manifest.

pm-nina: Release notes updated with pin + rollback plan + checklist link. Final QA signed off at 21:45 UTC.

alex: Great. We'll post a final ready-to-deploy at 22:50 UTC. If no objections by then, proceed with schedule. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary started for job_id=canary-1755009876 at 23:00:12 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary health checks: OK at +10m. No 5xx, p95 within 80ms of baseline.

alex: Canary looks healthy. Proceeding to 20% ramp at 23:20 UTC unless anyone objects.

maya: No objections from infra.

oncall-liz: I'm monitoring; will ping on anomalies.

deploy-bot: Canary ramped to 20% at 23:20:03 UTC.

raj: All post-ramp checks passing. Keeping an eye on logs for model mismatch warnings.

alex: If anything pops, we'll trigger rollback per plan. Otherwise we'll complete rollout at 23:50 UTC and mark the release as live.

pm-nina: Thanks team — I'll publish release notes and update the changelog after the final rollout.

alex: closing thread after final confirmation. Good job everyone.
